text:
evan: Hit a few annoying issues trying the JS SDK sample apps on Deno and Bun for an integration test. Types + ESM, and a retry edge-case that could double-send requests.
rachel: oof. quick details?
evan: 1) Deno throws: \"package.json exports do not contain ./deno\" when following README default import. 2) TS in Deno complains about default export vs named. 3) In Bun/Edge runtimes our automatic retry logic retriggers non-idempotent requests when a streaming response aborts, which could cause duplicate downstream calls.
mike: the retry problem is worrying for billing/customer actions. Is it triggered by fetch aborts or by network timeouts?
evan: saw it on a flaky edge node: SDK does a single retry on network error, but some runtimes surface a streamed-body error after headers, which we treat as network error and resend the whole request. For non-idempotent endpoints that means duplicate operations.
tara: we should do two things: a) stop retrying automatically for endpoints marked non-idempotent; b) make retries safer by using an idempotency-key header when available and not re-sending if the server reports the request was received.
rachel: agreed. On the Deno/Bun side, we should add an explicit deno entrypoint and publish an ESM named-export bundle + types. Suggest package.json exports like: {"./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs", ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}} and a dist/deno/index.d.ts for TS. Add examples/deno-quickstart and examples/bun-quickstart with deno.json/import_map and bun.lock.
mike: for the webcrypto issue: Bun sometimes lacks crypto.subtle -> auth signing fails. Wrap signing in a helper: const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle ?? await import('./shims/subtle.js'); so we dynamically import only when needed. Also normalize fetch body parsing: prefer response.json() then arrayBuffer fallback.
tara: I'll add SDK-level changes: mark endpoints non-retryable by default where appropriate and include idempotency-key in examples. Also add a runtime-adapters module exporting isDeno/isBun/isNode + fetchNormalize + subtleShim. Keep adapter small so it tree-shakes.
ev an: CI note: add matrix job to run the sample apps on node(18), deno(1.34+), bun nightly; the partner CI hit the Deno export error in their run.
ci-bot: created issue #910: "SDK: Deno/Bun DX + safe retries - deno export, types, subtle shim, fetch normalization, idempotency/retry rules" assigned to evan,tara,rachel.
evan: I'll open a PR for examples + package.json export change. tara will take retry/idempotency patch and tests. rachel will add types + README compatibility table.
mike: add a tiny troubleshooting section to quickstart: "If you see \"exports do not contain ./deno\", use `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` or upgrade SDK to >= x.y.z".
ev an: thanks all — prioritizing this since partner POC depends on safe retries and Deno quickstarts.
